newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 6.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 6.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A police commando freed a three-year girl who has been held captive for 40 days.
- The Hungarian capital's three poorest districts have joined forces in coordinating social programmes.
- The parliament's special committee has not yet finished its report on the "Tocsik-affair".
- Opposition parties Smallholders and Christian-Democrats have started talks on a joint election strategy.
- Hungary is for a world free of nuclear weapons but NATO-hopes call for careful pondering, Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs told environmentalists.
- NATO Secretary-General Javier Solana, on his way back from Turkey, will stop in Budapest for short talks with Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs
